title: The Michigan Daily's Games
description: I help maintain the codebase for The Michigan Daily's games. I've worked on changes to crossword puzzle clue logic and I'm currently building Ann Arbor Geoguessr.

title: Orientation Edition 2026
description: The Michigan Daily's annual new student edition featuring advice for incoming students. I helped with web development.

title: All About the State of Michigan's Fiscal Year Budget
description: A React-based website with links to a 3-part news series about the State of Michigan's FY26 budget. I was the sole developer.

title: Best of Ann Arbor 2025
description: Every year, The Michigan Daily compiles the most popular Ann Arbor businesses as voted on by our readership. In 2025, I helped develop the desktop-only image carousel.

title: Best of Ann Arbor 2024
description: Every year, The Michigan Daily compiles the most popular Ann Arbor businesses as voted on by our readership. In 2024, I served as the project manager and one of the web developers for the accompanying React-based website. Best viewed on desktop.

title: Students vs. Textbooks
description: A React-based website displaying the Michigan Daily's exploration of the impact of textbook costs on students. I helped develop the interactive textbook component at the bottom of the page.
